My local friendly engagement librarian told me about this legal alternative to Sci-Hub for finding articles that your institution may not pay for access to. Maybe everyone knows about it already, but I didn't.

It's called [Unpaywall](https://unpaywall.org) by [Our Research](https://ourresearch.org/) and is a browser extension for Firefox, Chrome.

Once the extension is installed and you navigate to your article of interest and find you can't access it, a green padlock to click on will appear (@fig-01) which will take you to the unpaywalled version if it's available (@fig-02).

![Unpaywalled Article](/images/unpaywalled-2025-02-18.png){#fig-02 fig-alt="Screenshot of the unpaywalled article"}
